meaning.en: A list of items to be noted, checked, or remembered.
meaning.vi: Một danh sách các mục cần ghi chú, kiểm tra hoặc ghi nhớ.

meaning.en: A list of things, names, etc. to be checked off or referred to for verifying, comparing, ordering, etc.
meaning.vi: Danh sách những thứ, tên, v.v. được đánh dấu hoặc được tham chiếu để xác minh, so sánh, sắp xếp, v.v.

meaning.en: The definition of a checklist is a list of things that can be checked off as completed or noted.
meaning.vi: Định nghĩa của danh sách kiểm tra là danh sách những thứ có thể được kiểm tra khi đã hoàn thành hoặc đã ghi chú.
Một bản kiểm kê, đặc biệt là về các loài.

meaning.en: A list of tasks to be completed, names to be consulted, conditions to be verified and similar.
meaning.vi: Danh sách các nhiệm vụ cần hoàn thành, tên cần tham khảo, các điều kiện cần được xác minh và các điều kiện tương tự.

sentences.en: Profiles or developmental checklists may help with this process of identifying strengths and goals for future learning when Portage visits begin.

sentences.en: The self-assessment checklists enabled students to be more independent in their learning.

sentences.en: The checklists are designed to be useful tick-box reminders to help you put good practice into action.

sentences.en: Checklists are a useful preliminary tool for expert assessment Full evaluation ultimately required road tests.

sentences.en: The two main research elements are the name and the distribution, both of which can be used to create individually tailored checklists.

sentences.en: Make as many newborn checklists as you like, and modify them as needed.

sentences.en: You'll also find state tax profiles, a glossary of tax terms, tax calculators and tax preparation checklists.

sentences.en: To avoid such charges, be sure to carefully read and follow your contract, as well as any checklists provided by the owner/ manager.

sentences.en: Products for Pilots sells laminated checklists for vital tasks that may not be second nature to amateur pilots, such as diverting to an alternate airport.

sentences.en: Momentville offers free websites for couples planning to get married along with many helpful tools such as checklists, budget tools, picture galleries and forums.
